# ScanLine

> AI-native inline CT inspection for manufacturing lines — physics-informed 3D quality decisions before every part leaves the line.

ScanLine builds high-speed inline industrial computed tomography (CT) and physics-informed AI reconstruction & defect-detection systems for automated manufacturing quality control.
